camel_example: aliyun kms GetParametersForImport --region cn-hangzhou --WrappingKeySpec RSA_2048 --KeyId '202b9877-5a25-46e3-a763-e20791b50000' --WrappingAlgorithm RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5
description_en: Queries the parameters that are used to import key material for a customer master key (CMK)
description_zh: 获取导入主密钥材料的参数
kebab_example: aliyun kms get-parameters-for-import --key-id 202b9877-5a25-46e3-a763-e20791b50000 --wrapping-algorithm RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5 --wrapping-key-spec RSA_2048 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetParametersForImport

parameters.help_en:
The globally unique ID of the CMK.

You can import key material only for CMKs whose Origin parameter is set to EXTERNAL
parameters.help_zh:
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。

密钥材料来源必须是外部，即Origin为EXTERNAL。
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The algorithm that is used to encrypt key material
parameters.help_zh: 用于加密密钥材料的算法
parameters.name: wrapping_algorithm

parameters.help_en: The type of the public key that is used to encrypt key material
parameters.help_zh: 用于加密密钥材料的公钥类型
parameters.name: wrapping_key_spec

ImportToken.description_en:
The token that is used to import key material.

The token is valid for 24 hours. The value of this parameter is required when you call the [ImportKeyMaterial]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68622.html） operation
ImportToken.description_zh:
导入令牌。  
令牌的有效期为24小时。后续调用[ImportKeyMaterial]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68622.html）时需要指定该参数。

KeyId.description_en:
The globally unique ID of the CMK.

The value of this parameter is required when you call the [ImportKeyMaterial]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68622.html） operation
KeyId.description_zh:
主密钥全局唯一标识符。  
后续调用[ImportKeyMaterial]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68622.html）时需要指定该参数。

PublicKey.description_en:
The public key that is used to encrypt key material.

The public key is Base64-encoded
PublicKey.description_zh:
用于加密密钥材料的公钥。  
采用Base64编码

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TokenExpireTime.description_en: The time when the token expires
